summary.en: Conan is delighted with his newly bought three detective novels from Haido bookstore, where Masumi recommended him to go for a good price, when he meets Masumi again. As she just finished repairing her motorbike and couldn’t open the bottle without filthying it, Conan has to do it for her. However, he does not know that the bottle was carbonated, and he ends up getting splashed over by the liquid inside. Luckily, since Masumi is currently living near the area, she can offer him a place to change his clothes, but he refuses as there have been two hotel bombing cases reported. Masumi then offers him to see the bombing code left at the bombing scene, sparking his interest. Fortunately, no death is reported. There were strange codes sent to the scene of the bombings. It turns out that the bottle Masumi asked him to open was an arrangement between her and her mother so that they can try to steal the antidote when he is taking a bath. However, he brought no antidotes today, so better luck next time!
